blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The dismantling of fixtures and materials from the Senate office recently vacated by Sen. Jinggoy Estrada was “standard practice,” his office said on Wednesday. According to them, “not a single centavo of public funds was wasted” in the process, adding that the dismantled items, which were bought using Estrada’s personal funds, will be reinstalled in his new office. “It must also be emphasized that similar instances of dismantling fixtures and materials from a vacated senator’s office have occurred in the recent past,” Estrada’s office said in a statement. “This is neither new nor unusual — it is an […]...
